description:
Set (or rotate) the organization's encryption keypair

Registers the organization's result encryption public key and turns on encrypted result delivery. Send only the public key; the private key stays with the developer. If the organization already has a different key, the call returns 409 unless you pass replace: true. Pass it only when the developer asked to rotate the key, because results encrypted to the old key can no longer be decrypted. Setting the same key again succeeds. To generate and store the private key in the project, use `issue_org_keypair` instead.

oneOf.description: Body for `PUT /orgs/{orgId}/keypair`. Carries the org's eth public key as an uncompressed hex string (`0x04` + 128 hex) — the eth-native form wallets/ethers emit. The matching private key never leaves the consumer.

replace.description: Set to true to replace an existing, different public key. Without it, the call returns 409 when the organization already has another key. Results encrypted to the old key can no longer be decrypted.

oneOf.description: Body for `PUT /orgs/{orgId}/keypair`. Carries the org's eth public key as a secp256k1 public JWK.

publicKeyJwk.description: A secp256k1 (Ethereum) public key in JWK form (`{kty:'EC', crv:'secp256k1', x, y}`), used to ECIES-encrypt delivered verification results and to identify the org. The matching private key never leaves the consumer. Same shape published by the signing JWKS.

replace.description: Set to true to replace an existing, different public key. Without it, the call returns 409 when the organization already has another key. Results encrypted to the old key can no longer be decrypted.

name: set_org_keypair
